difficulty_why: Building an app requires creating a separate developer sandbox account; private apps can be installed immediately via direct link without review, but public marketplace listing requires an extensive review process taking up to 21 business days.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Registering a developer sandbox account, opening Developer Hub, registering an app, configuring scopes, and obtaining OAuth credentials for testing.

launch_time.label: Same day to 4 weeks
launch_time.text: Private apps can be shared with customers immediately once marked live (same day); public apps submitted for Marketplace listing can take up to 21 business days for review.

own_app_reasons.label: Branded consent screen
own_app_reasons.text: Users see your product name and logo instead of a third-party app during OAuth authorization.

own_app_reasons.label: Independent rate limits
own_app_reasons.text: Own OAuth client credentials avoid sharing burst and daily token limits with other integrations.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom scope selection
own_app_reasons.text: Request only the specific entity permissions required by your application features.

app_type.label: Private App or Public Marketplace App
app_type.text: Create a Private App to connect accounts via a direct installation link without Marketplace review, or create a Public App if you plan to publish on the public Pipedrive Marketplace. App type cannot be changed once created.

prerequisites.label: Developer sandbox account
prerequisites.text: A free Pipedrive Developer Sandbox account created via the self-serve signup form without requiring a credit card.

prerequisites.label: Admin access in sandbox
prerequisites.text: Admin privileges within the sandbox company to access Settings and Developer Hub.

steps.label: Register developer sandbox account
steps.text: Go to developers.pipedrive.com and submit the Developer Sandbox account registration form. Confirm your email to activate the account.

steps.label: Navigate to Developer Hub
steps.text: Log in to your sandbox account, click your profile icon in the top right, select the sandbox company name, and click Developer Hub.

steps.label: Create app
steps.text: Click Create an app and choose Create private app (or Create public app if submitting for Marketplace listing).

steps.label: Configure Basic info
steps.text: In the Basic info tab, enter your App name and paste the Composio redirect URI into the Callback URL field, then click Save.

steps.label: Configure OAuth scopes
steps.text: Navigate to the OAuth & access scopes tab and check activities:full, contacts:full, leads:full, mail:full, products:full, and projects:full.

fields.label: Access scopes
fields.value: Activities: Full access, Contacts: Full access, Leads: Full access, Mail: Full access, Products: Full access, Projects: Full access

steps.label: Retrieve OAuth credentials
steps.text: Copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret from the OAuth & access scopes tab to enter into Composio.

steps.label: Change app status to live
steps.text: Click Save, then click the Change to live button to activate the app for external installations via direct link.

scopes.label: Activities Full Scope
scopes.text: activities:full provides full read and write access to Pipedrive activities without requiring restricted scope review.

scopes.label: Contacts Full Scope
scopes.text: contacts:full provides full read and write access to persons and organizations without requiring restricted scope review.

scopes.label: Leads Full Scope
scopes.text: leads:full provides full read and write access to leads without requiring restricted scope review.

scopes.label: Mail Full Scope
scopes.text: mail:full provides full read and write access to mail messages and threads without requiring restricted scope review.

scopes.label: Products Full Scope
scopes.text: products:full provides full read and write access to products without requiring restricted scope review.

scopes.label: Projects Full Scope
scopes.text: projects:full provides full read and write access to projects and tasks without requiring restricted scope review.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: Review is required only for public apps published on the Pipedrive Marketplace; private apps do not require review and can be installed via a direct installation link.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: Pipedrive reviews installation and uninstallation flows, OAuth 2.0 flow compliance, token refresh implementation, minimal scope justification, rate limiting adherence, and listing media.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Public app marketplace review may take up to 21 business days depending on queue volume.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Pipedrive does not charge any submission or review fee for marketplace apps.

approval.label: Common rejections
approval.text: Common rejections include requesting excessive scopes, using API tokens instead of OAuth 2.0, failing to refresh access tokens before the 60-minute expiry, and broken install flows.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: Draft apps can only be installed and tested within your developer sandbox account before being toggled to live or submitted for review.

pitfalls.label: Sandbox account requirement
pitfalls.text: Developer Hub is accessible only inside a Developer Sandbox account, not from standard production accounts.

pitfalls.label: Single callback URL limit
pitfalls.text: Pipedrive allows only one callback URL per registered OAuth app.

pitfalls.label: Sandbox inactivity expiration
pitfalls.text: Sandbox accounts are deleted if inactive for 45 days without creating an app, or 6 months without publishing an app or making a private app live.

pitfalls.label: Immutable app type
pitfalls.text: App type (public vs private) cannot be changed in Developer Hub once created; switching requires creating a new app.

pitfalls.label: All-or-nothing scope consent
pitfalls.text: Users cannot grant partial permissions; all requested scopes must be accepted together at installation.

pitfalls.label: 60-minute token expiration
pitfalls.text: Pipedrive OAuth access tokens expire after 60 minutes and must be refreshed regularly using refresh tokens.

support.label: Developer support email
support.text: Email marketplace developer support at marketplace.devs@pipedrive.com.

support.label: Developer Community
support.text: Ask questions and get help on the official Pipedrive Developers Community forum at devcommunity.pipedrive.com.

support.label: Developer Documentation
support.text: Official developer guides and API reference at https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs.

email_subject: OAuth App Review and Distribution Inquiry - [Your Product Name]
email_body:
Hi Pipedrive Marketplace Team,

We are developing an AI agent integration ([Your Product Name]) that allows Pipedrive users to connect their accounts via OAuth 2.0 using Composio.

We plan to request the following OAuth scopes:
- activities:full
- contacts:full
- leads:full
- mail:full
- products:full
- projects:full

Our OAuth redirect URI is:
https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add

Could you please confirm:
1. Whether private apps distributed via direct installation links have any installation count limits or account eligibility restrictions across external customer domains.
2. If we submit for public Marketplace listing, what the current queue turnaround time is, and whether requesting these full access scopes requires specialized security verification or audit documentation.
3. Any specific requirements for token refresh handling and rate limiting guidelines we should keep in mind during review.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Company / Product]
[Your Contact Information]

checks.label: Composio toolkit
checks.text: Composio has a toolkit for Pipedrive (`pipedrive`); Composio-managed OAuth app: no; auth methods: OAUTH2, API_KEY

checks.label: Authorize URL
checks.text: Authorize URL is live and rejects an unregistered client_id, so you need a real registered app

observed.label: Self-serve sandbox signup form
observed.text: Developer signup is self-serve via the Sandbox Account form on developers.pipedrive.com, requiring only E-mail, First Name, and agreeing to Terms of Service, Developer Agreement, and Privacy Notice.

observed.label: No credit card required for signup
observed.text: The sandbox registration form does not ask for credit card information or payment details.

observed.label: Public developer portal navigation
observed.text: The developer landing page provides direct navigation to Docs & guides, Changelog, Community, API clients, and the sandbox signup.
